content_record.title: historical-2024-dermal-fibroblast-senescence-the-hidden-driver-of-skin-aging-and-syste-3eb0029f
content_record.editorial_body: New review maps how ROS-induced fibroblast senescence disrupts the extracellular matrix, fuels chronic inflammation, and accelerates aging across the body. Three things to remember - ROS accumulation triggers fibroblast senescence and SASP-mediated inflammation. - Senescent fibroblasts disrupt ECM homeostasis, reducing dermal thickness and elasticity. - Nrf2, mTOR, TGF-β, and IGF-1 pathways regulate these aging processes. Source This signal is based on Aging in the dermis: Fibroblast senescence and its significance. from PubMed. Read the original report for full context. Health note: This is a review, not original data; specific mechanisms and pathway interactions remain to be fully detailed.
